clue.text: Evidently swinging, OK with man instead

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Cuddling up to sweetheart; next, I remove book

taken as written

clue.text: Astonished one has top job in Fleet Street?

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Elizabeth I, known as Bess, never married and was styled the Virgin Queen in her lifetime.

clue.text: Bans bank having such difficulties?

clue.text: Get free reinterpretation of Schiller and Plato?

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Go on eating a single sausage

taken as written

clue.text: Fish northern champ catches, maybe

clue.text: Hawkeye's hospital permit cyclically moves feast

clue.text: See 2
Most flexible option for replacement of shilling? It's debatable

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Continue to yak country

parts.note: taken as written
